scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode development && vite build --mode development --config vite.content.config.ts && npm run validate:extension
scripts.build:store: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode store && vite build --mode store --config vite.content.config.ts && npm run validate:store
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.test:native: swift run --package-path native ClipboardPlusStoreCheck && swift build -c release --package-path native --product ClipboardPlusCompanion && swift build -c release --package-path native --product ClipboardPlusNativeHost && node scripts/test-native-host.mjs
